transcript: This is a study that every single chess player should know. In this position, white is without any hope to save the game. The black pawn is going to promote to a queen and the king is just too far away to stop it. And if the white pawn tries to promote, well, the black king is very much in time to stop that. But white actually has a drawing mechanism in this position. And it starts with the beautiful king G7. The white king is not deciding yet which direction he wants to go in. He's leaving the options open as the black pawn keeps walking towards getting a new queen while the white king keeps following this diagonal path. The white king is approaching both his pawn and the opponent's pawn at the same time. Black cannot allow the white king to get too close to the pawn because that is going to allow him to get a queen of his own and this position would be a draw. For that reason, the black king now walks towards the white pawn. But now, once again, the king goes to E5, still marching along this diagonal. It's still getting closer to the black pawn and to the white pawn at the same time. Now, if black decides to take the white pawn, white has just gained enough time to finally stop the black pawn and draw the game. And if the black pawn decides to walk, well, now white is just in time to defend his own pawn and get a new [Music] queen at the same time as black and draw the game. Sometimes what seems completely impossible just so happens to be possible.
